subject: Renewal: premium support uplift + reserved burst capacity

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 14 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal: premium support uplift + reserved burst capacity

Hi Emma —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our renewal window next month, I attached a concise proposal that (a) upgrades Clearview to Redwood Premium Support, (b) adds a 30% reserved burst pool (2.4M tokens/day peak) for traffic spikes, and (c) includes a 12-month term extension with an upfront credit for committed capacity.

Highlights:
- Premium Support: 24x7 priority routing, 15-minute P1 response, dedicated CSM & quarterly SLO reviews.
- Latency SLO: 95th percentile token latency target of <120ms for standard inference routes; automatic fallback to secondary model variants under severe load.
- Capacity: Reserved burst pool billed at a discounted rate with predictable throttling and emergency burst allotment.
- Pricing: ~18% uplift over current list in exchange for guaranteed capacity and SLA banding; details in attachment.

Attachments: redwood-premium-proposal-CLRV-2026.pdf (pdf, 245KB), SLA-term-sheet-CLRV-2026.docx (docx, 42KB)

Next steps I propose:
1) You confirm the target SLO and burst reserve size (the proposal assumes 2.4M tokens/day).
2) We coordinate legal for a short addendum to the Master Services Agreement.
3) If approved, I’ll route to finance for the invoice schedule and to engineering for an onboarding playbook.

Can we do a 30-minute call on Tuesday (6/16) to run through the SLO examples and the operational handoffs?

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

3) Timing: we’re aligned on an annual term extension, but finance prefers net-30 invoicing if possible.
